subtitleEn: Chat about the weather and plan a park hike.

quests.blurbEn: Ask a friend about the weather and answer.

culture.textEn: Korea's national parks are home to nearly 200 kinds of endangered animals and plants. Keeping the parks safe helps these living things too.

sources.title: 우리나라 국립공원
sources.quoteOrLocator: ‘국내 기록 생물종 60,010종 중 23,777종 서식·분포하며, 국내 멸종위기종(282종)에 한정하여 보았을 때는 69%에 달하는 195종이 국립공원 내 서식하는 것으로 확인되었습니다.’

sources.title: 멸종위기야생생물관리
sources.quoteOrLocator: ‘국립공원 내 지정및분포 현황’: 양서파충류 I급 1종, II급 5종; 어류 I급 4종, II급 11종; 곤충 I급 8종, II급 20종; 육상식물 I급 9종, II급 40종; 포유류 I급 7종, II급 5종; 조류 I급 10종, II급 49종; 기타 I급 2종, II급 14종 (185 in all on this page, 195 on 우리나라 국립공원; nearly 200 holds for both)

verification.notes:
Pass 1 (author sourcing, CM-41 S4, 2026-10-30): the Korea National Park Service page 우리나라 국립공원 says 195 of Korea's 282 endangered species live in the national parks; its 멸종위기야생생물관리 page lists the endangered species in the parks by group (185 in all). 'Nearly 200' holds for both. English paraphrase, no count of n of m shown.
Pass 2 (independent MAR culture and facts, a reviewer agent other than the author, 2026-10-30): both pages fetched again; 195종 and the group table (185) found; publisher 국립공원공단 as on the access date; child-safe tone; es and ko match. Holds.
Pass 3 (MAR language and learning design, independent reviewers, 2026-10-30): es and ko text and the {ko:} tokens checked; no native-speaker or expert review is claimed.

culture.textEn: Since 2007 the Korea National Park Service has named flagship species, wild animals and plants that stand for a park. Bukhansan's is the great spotted woodpecker, called the doctor of the forest.

sources.title: 국립공원깃대종
sources.quoteOrLocator: ‘깃대종(Flagship Species)은 특정지역의 생태·지리·문화적 특성을 반영하는 상징적인 야생 동·식물로서 사람들이 보호해야 할 필요성이 인정되는 종입니다. 국립공원 공단은 2007년부터 22개 국립공원을 대상으로 총 43종의 야생 동·식물을 깃대종으로 지정하여 관리하고 있습니다.’ / 북한산국립공원 깃대종: ‘오색딱다구리’, ‘긴 혀를 이용하여 나무 줄기속에 살고 있는 애벌레를 잡어 먹어 ‘숲속의 의사’라는 별명이 있는 동물’

sources.title: 국립공원 깃대종을 아십니까? (기후변화 위기 속 국립공원의 역할 ②, 2019.10.04)
sources.quoteOrLocator: ‘우리나라에는 지난 2007년부터 국립공원마다 깃대종이 선정되기 시작했다.’ / ‘깃대종은 특정지역의 생태·지리·문화적 특성을 반영하는 상징적인 야생 동·식물로서 …’ (its count, 21 parks and 41 species, is as of 2019; today's 22 and 43 are the Korea National Park Service's)

verification.notes:
Pass 1 (author sourcing, CM-41 S4, 2026-10-30): the Korea National Park Service page 국립공원깃대종 defines a flagship species (상징적인 야생 동·식물), says the Service has named them since 2007 (22 parks, 43 species today) and gives Bukhansan's, the great spotted woodpecker (오색딱다구리), nicknamed 숲속의 의사. The korea.kr column of 2019, written with the Service, says flagship species were first chosen in 2007. English paraphrase; no count is claimed.
Pass 2 (independent MAR culture and facts, a reviewer agent other than the author, 2026-10-30): both sources fetched again; 2007, the definition and the nickname found; 21 parks and 41 species in the 2019 column are noted as of 2019 and not used. Holds.
Pass 3 (MAR language and learning design, independent reviewers, 2026-10-30): es (especies bandera, pico picapinos) and ko checked; no native-speaker or expert review is claimed.

culture.textEn: Seoraksan's flagship species is the long-tailed goral, {ko:산양}. It lives on steep, rocky cliffs, and more gorals live on Seoraksan than anywhere else in Korea.

sources.title: 국립공원깃대종
sources.quoteOrLocator: 설악산국립공원 깃대종: ‘산양 (Naemorhedus caudatus)’, ‘설악산은 국내 최대 산양 서식지(약 250마리 이상)’, ‘서식지 : 천적을 피해 경사가 급하고 바위가 많은 산악지대에서 생활함’

sources.title: 산양
sources.quoteOrLocator: ‘사람의 접근이 힘든 험준한 바위절벽을 중심으로 살아가는 산양은 2020년 약 2,000마리 정도가 비무장지대, 설악산, 양구-화천, 울진-봉화-삼척 등에서 살아가고 있는 것으로 추정되었습니다.’

verification.notes:
Pass 1 (author sourcing, CM-41 S4, 2026-10-30): the Korea National Park Service page 국립공원깃대종 names the long-tailed goral (산양) as Seoraksan's flagship species, calls Seoraksan the largest goral habitat in Korea (국내 최대 산양 서식지) and gives its habitat as steep, rocky mountains; the Service's 산양 page says the goral lives around steep rock cliffs. English paraphrase; no population number is claimed, and the causes of decline are left out (child-safe tone).
Pass 2 (independent MAR culture and facts, a reviewer agent other than the author, 2026-10-30): both pages fetched again; 산양, 국내 최대 산양 서식지 and 험준한 바위절벽 found. Holds.
Pass 3 (MAR language and learning design, independent reviewers, 2026-10-30): es and ko checked, one {ko:산양} token each; no native-speaker or expert review is claimed.
